name: How is ground-up construction different from renovation or addition work?

mainEntity.name: How is ground-up construction different from renovation or addition work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovations and additions modify or expand an existing structure, while ground-up construction creates an entirely new building and foundation, offering more freedom in layout, structure, and systems. cubework+1
